term.es: de poner por la cabeza o los pies

definition.en: The capability of a garment that is put on by passing over the body rather than by opening: no zip, no buttons, nothing to undo. The whole fit question becomes one measurement — the narrowest opening against the widest part it must pass — and the fabric's stretch is what reconciles them.
definition.es: La capacidad de una prenda que se pone pasándola por el cuerpo en lugar de abrirla: sin cremallera, sin botones, sin nada que desabrochar. Toda la cuestión del ajuste se reduce a una medida —la abertura más estrecha frente a la parte más ancha que debe pasar— y la elasticidad de la tela es lo que las reconcilia.
definition.fr: La capacité d'un vêtement qu'on enfile en le faisant passer sur le corps plutôt qu'en l'ouvrant : pas de glissière, pas de boutons, rien à défaire. Toute la question de l'ajustement se réduit à une mesure — l'ouverture la plus étroite face à la partie la plus large qu'elle doit franchir — et l'élasticité du tissu est ce qui les réconcilie.
definition.pt: A capacidade de uma peça que se veste passando-a pelo corpo em vez de a abrir: sem fecho, sem botões, sem nada para desapertar. Toda a questão do ajuste se reduz a uma medida — a abertura mais estreita face à parte mais larga que tem de passar — e a elasticidade do tecido é o que as reconcilia.

aliases.name: pull_on
aliases.note: hyperobject.capabilities key; declared by 9 cartridges and true on 7 as of 2026-09-02.

constraints: The opening must clear the widest point ON THE WAY IN, which is rarely the point it will sit on: a waistband that fits the waist has to pass the hip, and a neck opening that fits the neck has to pass the head — `head_girth` appears on 30 cartridges for exactly this reason.
